title: Did Celestin have two bands?
summary: Discussion of whether Celestin led two bands; Dejan explains the Ridgley and Celestin Tuxedo bands of the 1920s.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I've heard it sometime in the later days that Salisand had two bands. Did he have two in those days? Like one on the road one?
Well, no, he didn't have one band at that time. One band. That was before he went in the paddock. Yeah.
Before. Yeah. Did he did. Do you remember having two bands? One on the road one there? No, I don't remember that. Some people say he talked like he had two of them. Why?
No, during the time I was with him, he was with the band. He was always with the band. He was always with the band.
Because he would tell them, sometime before he sent them for his job, he would tell the people that he can't play it. Yeah.
So I wondered, because some people said, oh, they called one the society band. Like these people.

But here's what they must have been thinking about, you see. You see, when Salisand Ridley broke up, we had Riznitz tuxedo, and Salisand's tuxedo, you see, because I was on the road with Riznitz tuxedo in the 20s. Yeah, that may be what I heard then. Yeah, that's what I heard. Me, Emma, Barry, Gilbert, Young, my brother Leo, and this trombone player I was telling you about that stayed dressed up all the time. We all changed clothes, you know, right on the road, and he'd stay dressed up just in his tuxedo suit. And when we'd get out the bus, we'd go change clothes and everything, and he still didn't look no better than he looked. Yeah, I mean, he stayed clean all the time.
That's how he did it. Yeah, it's hard to do.
Well, that's what must have happened. They were two tuxedos, you see. It was Riznitz tuxedo and Salisand's tuxedo.
See, that's what happened. It might have been on the late days that he was sent out on the- stuff

band of the job he couldn't take. Couldn't take. Maybe so. He sent some people out someplace. People think it was his band, but without him. Well, let's see. After Celestan, then, is there anything else to tell about Celestan's band? You always played the banjo, I know.
